meta_description: Book 30A Beach Retreat | Gulf Views + Pool + Hot Tub directly on LocalVR for the best rates. No third-party fees. Experience the best of the Emerald Coast at this Seacrest Beach vacation rental, located just steps from deeded beach access. Spanning 3 levels, this home featu...
description_expanded: SummaryExperience the best of the Emerald Coast at this Seacrest Beach vacation rental, located just steps from deeded beach access. Spanning 3 levels, this home features Gulf views from the top-floor balcony and includes 4 adult bikes for exploring the scenic Timpoochee Trail. Guests enjoy access to a community pool and hot tub, plus a private gas grill for evening cookouts. With spacious living areas and room for the whole family, it is the perfect 30A getaway.SpaceDiscover peace and tranquility at Seacrest Beach, a beautifully renovated haven nestled along the Emerald Coast. This inviting beach home is designed for unwinding and reconnecting with nature, offering a peaceful retreat for the whole family. With two luxurious master suites, a cozy queen room, and a whimsical bunk room for the kids (with three twin beds and a bonus full-sized bed), everyone has their own space to relax. Surrounded by lush live oaks and charming beach bungalows, Seacrest Beach provides access to a serene neighborhood pool and hot tub—a perfect spot to rest beneath the coastal oaks. Just a short stroll away, deeded beach access leads you to pristine sands and breathtaking sunsets over the Gulf. The nearby village areas of Alys and Rosemary Beach are within walking or biking distance, offering trendy cafés, unique shops, and opportunities to explore. Inside, the open ground floor is designed for comfort, featuring a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, beautiful oak floors, and sleek marble-look quartz countertops. The cozy living area and convenient laundry room add to the ease of your stay, while upstairs, additional bedrooms and bathrooms provide ample space for everyone to retreat. Escape to the third-floor master suite for complete privacy, where you’ll find an ensuite bath and a private balcony with sweeping Gulf views—perfect for peaceful sunset moments. The private back patio is nestled among trees, creating an intimate setting for al fresco dining and evening cookouts by the grill. Whether you’re strolling to the beach to savor the emerald waters or enjoying the serenity of the community pool, Bluebird Beach offers a tranquil getaway close to all the natural beauty and quiet charm of 30A. Please note: Golf carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined. SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS (10): - Master Bedroom: King sized bed, ensuite bathroom - Master Bedroom 2: Queen sized bed, ensuite bathroom with tub/shower combo - Guest bedroom: Queen sized bed, shared bathroom with tub/shower combo - Bunk Room: Twin over full bed and a twin over twin bunk bed, shared bath with tub/shower combo HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - The Cottages at Camp Creek are a quick stroll to the 18 mile Timpoochee Trail where you can walk, bike or jog to exploe the many communities along 30A - Neighborhood has beach access across the road - Close to Alys (1 mile) Rosemary (1.5 miles) and The big Chill (2 miles) FEATURES: - Gulf Views - Community Pool and Hot tub - Stone Patio with table for 6 - Gas Grill - Easy Beach AccessNeighborhoodSeacrest Beach is located in the Cottages at Camp Creek, a charming coastal community near the best of 30A. The Timpoochee Trail offers scenic walking and biking, while nearby Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach provide upscale dining, boutique shopping, and picturesque architecture. TransitThe home is best accessed by car, but bike rentals are a popular way to explore 30A. The neighborhood prohibits golf carts in Seacrest Beach. AccessGuests have full access to the home, private balconies and community pool and hot tub. Notes— Pool and hot tub available for guest use, we are not in control of unexpected repairs. — Please keep in mind that if you plan to visit the beach, you are responsible for verifying public access regulations House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 19. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 20. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. 21. Bicycles must yield to pedestrians when riding on sidewalks. Use designated crosswalks and follow all traffic laws. 22. Helmets are required for riders under 16. Nighttime riding requires a front light and rear reflectors for visibility. 23. Only licensed and insured drivers may operate golf carts and low-speed vehicles (LSVs). 24. Golf carts and LSVs must follow Florida motor vehicle laws and may only be driven on roads with speed limits of 35 mph or less. 25. Golf carts and LSVs may not be driven on sidewalks or bike paths. Working headlights and taillights are required for nighttime use. 26. Bicycles must be locked when parked and marked with identification for return. Guests are responsible for any loss, theft, or damage during the rental. 27. Golf cart and LSV drivers must ensure all passengers wear seatbelts and do not exceed passenger limits. 28. Reckless driving or unauthorized modifications to golf carts and LSVs is prohibited. Park responsibly and return vehicles clean and fully charged or refueled. 29. LSVs and bicycles are not allowed within the Rosemary Beach Community. 30. Guests are responsible for any fines, tickets, or damages incurred during use. Bicycles and golf carts/LSVs must be returned in the same condition as provided. 31. Guests acknowledge the inherent risks of using bicycles and operating golf carts/LSVs. 32. Guests agree to indemnify and hold harmless LocalVR, its owners, and employees from any claims or damages arising from use. 33. LocalVR and the property owner are not liable for injuries or damages incurred, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct.Read Less
